overview: Anthropic’s IPO coincides with a contested Riemann hypothesis claim using Claude.
Large‑scale canary testing reveals systemic data leaks across AI routing services.
Nvidia’s earnings and leadership turmoil highlight market volatility amid AI funding shifts.

top.title: Anthropic's IPO Bust Deepens $4T AI Wipeout on Wall Street
top.summary: Anthropic’s IPO failed, contributing to a $4 trillion AI market correction on Wall Street, underscoring investor skepticism about frontier AI valuations.

top.title: Anthropic mathematician claims to have solved prestigious Millennium Prize problem with Claude
top.summary: Levent Alpöge asserts he proved the Riemann hypothesis with Claude’s assistance; the proof, posted in Lean, awaits independent verification and prize eligibility.

top.title: AI may have solved the most important problem in mathematics
top.summary: Discussion on Hacker News highlights the claim that AI may have solved the Riemann hypothesis, reflecting community interest in AI‑driven mathematics breakthroughs.

top.title: Researcher plants 2m canaries into the AI supply chain. A privacy disaster surfaced.
top.summary: Researcher deployed two million secret‑laden prompts across AI routers, uncovering widespread leakage of sensitive data at multiple service providers.

top.title: AI claimed a solution to the 167-year-old Riemann hypothesis — and a human did, too
top.summary: TechCrunch reports Alpöge’s Lean‑based Riemann hypothesis proof, noting early peer confirmation but stressing the need for human‑readable validation.

top.title: The fallout from Nvidia’s Jensen Huang scandal continues
top.summary: Nvidia reported earnings growth while halting H200 chip sales in China and facing leadership fallout, raising questions about AI industry funding cycles.
